Trace, implement and test: remove Chars

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
let txt = prompt("Enter Text :");
let num = Number(prompt("Remove How Many Characters?"));
document.write("Entered Text : " + txt + "<br>");

function removeChars(text, number) {
    return text.substring(number);
}

document.write("After Removing " + num + " Chars : " + removeChars(txt, num));
